verdict.rationale: Pendo documents some non-UI programmatic operations: Track Events can be sent as REST API calls, and an API endpoint bulk-deletes accounts and visitors without contacting support. That gives thin, operation-specific headless automation, but there is no CLI, no CI integration guidance, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/CD usage, a comprehensive published API spec, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use the API endpoint to delete accounts and visitors without contacting our support team.
